en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4876 - Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbub narrated from Ibn Bukayr from ʿUbayd ibn Zurarah who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a sick man who divorces his wife in that state (of illness).
Imam (as) said: "No, but he may marry if he wishes. If he consummates the marriage, she will inherit from him. However, if he does not consummate the marriage, then his marriage is invalid."
